insights.title: Pentair plc (PNR) Notice of October 2, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit
insights.claim: A securities fraud class action lawsuit against Pentair plc has been expanded to cover an earlier period (March 11, 2025 – July 14, 2026). The lawsuit alleges the company made materially false statements about its financial health and channel inventory, particularly in its Pool segment. On July 14, 2026, Pentair shocked investors with a massive revenue miss ($930M vs. $1.14B forecast), revealed $170M in inventory destocking impacts, slashed full-year guidance, and announced an abrupt CFO departure. The stock plummeted 15% the following day.
